channel.title: LLM
channel.description: Muhammad Hassan Raza runs product and engineering at Entropy Labs, builds backend and AI systems that hold up in production, and gets patches merged into open-source tools like kitty, calibre and libtorrent.

item.title: Scoring Fraud in Legal Intake Calls
item.description: Coached callers, invented doctors and borrowed photos. How RISQ scores intake calls for mass tort firms, and why the most useful score is the one that grades the interviewer.

item.title: LLMs Can't Save Bad UX
item.description: When an AI feature flops, look at the UX before you blame the model. Three features I watched fail, what fixed them, and the questions I now ask before anyone writes a prompt.
